# FitCheck AI

> FitCheck AI is a free Android app that rates outfits, makeup and hairstyles from a photo, giving a style score with tips on fit, color and balance. Outfit scoring runs on your device and photos are not stored by FitCheck.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/): What FitCheck does and where to download it
- [How it works](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/how-it-works.html): Upload a photo, get a score and tips
- [AI outfit checker](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-outfit-checker/)
- [AI makeup assistant](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-makeup-assistant/)
- [AI hairstyle try-on](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-hairstyle-try-on/)
- [AI skin analysis](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-skin-analysis/)
- [Digital wardrobe](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/digital-wardrobe/)
- [Virtual outfit try-on](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/virtual-outfit-try-on/)
- [App comparisons](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/compare/)
- [Blog: style, hair, makeup and skin guides](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/)
